Named return function.description: A Moxie function must name every return value.

Pointer receiver method.description: Only method receivers may be written to, and only a pointer receiver is allowed in user code.

Sovereign self-mutating type.description: A named struct with a method that stores into a receiver field owns a sovereign arena.

init and zero-value globals.description: A program's main package cannot declare init; other packages use init() plus zero-value globals.

Slice with length and capacity.description: Presize exactly and write through a cursor. There is no make().

Ensure before a spread push.description: push does not grow; a spread needs Ensure(len(src)) first.

Spawn a worker.description: Channels are fixed at spawn time; a worker serves its inbox and is never spawned per job.

Interface implementation assertion.description: There is no reflect and no empty interface; assert to a named interface.

Error return.description: Named returns plus errors.New from the errors package.
